composition.effectiveAuthority: user-project-authority intersect role-ceiling intersect executor-grant intersect transport-enforcement

roles.title: Scout
roles.intent: Collect source-backed facts, options, dependencies, and material unknowns.
useWhen: several evidence sources can be inspected independently
avoidWhen: the task requires implementation rather than investigation

concurrencyProfile.hardConstraint: no mutation of project or external state

stopAndEscalation: facts conflict without a resolvable source

roles.title: Architect
roles.intent: Design system boundaries, interfaces, alternatives, and explicit trade-offs.
useWhen: competing designs would improve a high-impact decision
avoidWhen: the contract and implementation path are already settled
only a local mechanical edit remains
authorityCeiling: write design artifacts only when explicitly scoped

concurrencyProfile.hardConstraint: design proposals do not mutate shared implementation state

stopAndEscalation: a product decision lacks acceptance criteria
required authority or migration scope is unknown
antiPatterns: turning a proposal into implicit authorization

roles.title: Builder
roles.intent: Implement and locally verify an exact bounded change scope.
useWhen: a write scope and acceptance are explicit
an isolated implementation or competing candidate is useful
avoidWhen: no isolated mutable surface can be assigned
deliverables: working changes or bounded local commits
evidenceObligations: report base/head and scan when commits are allowed
authorityCeiling: create bounded local commits only under the Git envelope
never adopt or update protected/base state

conditions: cannot independently check its own work

concurrencyProfile.hardConstraint: no concurrent write to one shared mutable surface

stopAndEscalation: verification fails outside the bounded fix

roles.title: Reviewer
roles.intent: Challenge a plan, contract, or change and return reproducible prioritized findings.
useWhen: non-primary judgment can change the outcome
risk or blast radius requires adversarial review
avoidWhen: the reviewer built the same slice
the request is to implement fixes rather than assess them
authorityCeiling: record review Evidence when explicitly authorized

conditions: actor did not build the reviewed slice

concurrencyProfile.hardConstraint: no mutation of the reviewed implementation

antiPatterns: treating style preference as a blocker

roles.title: Verifier
roles.intent: Independently reproduce acceptance, failure paths, and completion evidence.
useWhen: a completion claim needs independent proof
critical acceptance can be reproduced without implementation writes
avoidWhen: the actor implemented the verified slice
verification requires an unapproved external effect
evidenceObligations: distinguish pass, fail, not-run, and blocked
do not infer completion from exit or session stability
authorityCeiling: record test Evidence when explicitly authorized

conditions: actor did not build the verified slice

concurrencyProfile.hardConstraint: verification side effects are isolated or explicitly serialized

antiPatterns: turning an environment gap into a pass

roles.title: Integrator
roles.intent: Compose isolated outputs, reconcile bounded conflicts, and prepare an integration candidate.
useWhen: the Executor delegates bounded reconciliation on a non-protected surface
avoidWhen: final adoption or protected integration is the requested decision
source slices lack review or clear provenance
evidenceObligations: preserve source commit or patch identity
separate prepared candidate from adopted result
authorityCeiling: compose on an assigned non-protected isolated surface
create candidate or reconciliation commits only while also carrying Builder Role under a complete Builder Git Envelope
perform exact clean inbound adoption only after the Executor decides adoption and grants an Integration Git Envelope
never update protected/base or remote state

conditions: integration work requires a separate Reviewer or Verifier when a check is required

concurrencyProfile.hardConstraint: one accountable owner writes the assigned integration surface at a time

stopAndEscalation: adoption requires protected or external action
